title: APPR � Eligible � 2 Adult Pax � Delay Code 06 (Airport) � Booker Basic Member � All Expenses Total Exceeds $800 Policy Cap -> Pending Agent Review (Manual)
goal: Verify APPR SOC eligibility, group entitlement evaluation, OCR line-item processing across four categories (Meals, Transport, Accommodation, Essentials), and manual review escalation for a 2-adult booking (1 Basic Aeroplan booker + 1 non-member) experiencing a 7-hour controllable airport-related delay (Code 06), where submitted expenses total $980.00 CAD (exceeding the $800.00 CAD total case threshold) and trigger routing to the Manual Handling Queue for agent review before any Interac payout issuance.

checkpoints.step: Verify APPR SOC eligibility, group entitlement evaluation, OCR line-item processing across four categories (Meals, Transport, Accommodation, Essentials), and manual review escalation for a 2-adult booking (1 Basic Aeroplan booker + 1 non-member) experiencing a 7-hour controllable airport-related delay (Code 06), where submitted expenses total $980.00 CAD (exceeding the $800.00 CAD total case threshold) and trigger routing to the Manual Handling Queue for agent review before any Interac payout issuance.

checkpoints.step: Given the user opens the agentic chatbot
Then the chatbot displays greeting (GLOB-01):
checkpoints.expected: Hello! I will be your virtual assistant today. I can assist you in English or French. Which language would you prefer to use today?

checkpoints.step: When the user selects English
Then an alert information is displayed:
checkpoints.expected: Please note that by using this service, you will interact with an automated chatbot which uses AI to answer your questions and requests. Your personal information will be used to identify and authenticate you, to answer your request, and for other purposes detailed in the Privacy Notice.

checkpoints.step: Then the chatbot asks: "How can I help you today?"
checkpoints.expected: How can I help you today?

checkpoints.step: And the user says: "My flight from Toronto to Vancouver was delayed by 7 hours due to airport ground handling operations. There were 2 of us traveling and we incurred high expenses for hotel, meals, transport, and essential items. Can we get reimbursed?"
checkpoints.expected: My flight from Toronto to Vancouver was delayed by 7 hours due to airport ground handling operations. There were 2 of us traveling and we incurred high expenses for hotel, meals, transport, and essential items. Can we get reimbursed?

checkpoints.step: When the chatbot identifies Standards of Care (SoC) intent
Then the chatbot checks: Is this a third-party submission? -> NO
Then the chatbot displays the case opening legal disclaimer (GenUC-24):
checkpoints.expected: Please note that the assessment and decision regarding your request will be made through an automated decision-making process. To file your claim, you'll need your booking reference, the name associated to the booking and any receipts you'd like to be reimbursed for. If your claim is eligible, you may also need to provide your address, contact information and where you'd like the funds deposited. Would you like to get started?

checkpoints.step: Then the chatbot responds:
checkpoints.expected: I can definitely help you with that. To start I'll just need to know some information to be able to process your request and identify you.

checkpoints.step: And the chatbot responds:
checkpoints.expected: Please provide your full name exactly as it appears on your ticket, including any middle names if applicable.

checkpoints.step: And the user provides "[First Name] [Last Name]"
checkpoints.expected: [First Name] [Last Name]

checkpoints.step: Then the chatbot responds:
checkpoints.expected: Thanks, [First Name]! And, what is your booking reference number?

checkpoints.step: And the user provides "PNR: [PNR Code]"
checkpoints.expected: PNR: [PNR Code]

checkpoints.step: Then the chatbot searches Trip Tracer for PNR: [PNR Code]

checkpoints.step: And the chatbot displays options:

checkpoints.step: When the user selects "Email: t***@gmail.com"

checkpoints.step: Then the chatbot responds:
checkpoints.expected: I've sent a verification code to your email, please enter it within 15 minutes of receiving it.

checkpoints.step: And the user provides the OTP code "546879"
Then the chatbot validates the OTP code -> CORRECT (attempt 1 of 5)
Then the chatbot responds:
checkpoints.expected: Your verification was successful. Let's proceed to the next step.

checkpoints.step: Then the chatbot checks if this PNR is a group booking -> No
Then the chatbot checks if there are multiple PAX on PNR? -> YES (2 PAX found)

checkpoints.step: When the user confirms: "Yes, claiming for both passengers"
checkpoints.expected: Yes, claiming for both passengers

checkpoints.step: Then the chatbot retrieves booking details and displays:
checkpoints.expected: I found the following journey: * Flight: AC 301 * Route: Toronto (YYZ) -> Vancouver (YVR) * Date: June 15, 2026 * Departure Delay: 7 hours (420 minutes) * Passengers: 2 Adults Is this the journey you'd like to check?

checkpoints.step: And the user confirms "Yes"
checkpoints.expected: Yes

checkpoints.step: Then the chatbot checks if there is more than 1 segment -> No
Then the chatbot sends request to Case Services for duplicate check (GenUC-10)

Then the chatbot checks 72-hour window passed -> YES
Then the chatbot verifies Filing deadline limitation:
checkpoints.expected: * Origin: YYZ (Ontario) -> Limitation = 730 days * Destination: YVR (British Columbia) -> Limitation = 1,095 days * Elapsed: Within limitation period -> PROCEED

checkpoints.step: Then the chatbot checks if triage data is available -> YES
Then DDS evaluates backend rules:
checkpoints.expected: * Delay Code: 06 (Airport Operations / Ground Handling) -> Controllable * Passenger Type: 2 Regular Adults -> Standard handling * Booker Status: Aeroplan Basic (Pax 1 only) * Delay Band: DELAY_6_HOURS_OR_MORE (Overnight eligible) * Operating Airline: Air Canada (AC)

checkpoints.step: And DDS assigns Response Code: SoC-APPR-EL-08
Then the system sends case data to CyberSource for fraud screening
And CyberSource returns: GREEN (no fraud indicators detected)
Then the chatbot displays:
checkpoints.expected: Great news! Based on the details of your flight, you and the passenger on your booking are eligible for expense reimbursement. Your flight AC 301 from Toronto to Vancouver was delayed by approximately 7 hours due to airport ground operations. Under the applicable regulations (APPR), you may be reimbursed for reasonable expenses incurred during this disruption.

checkpoints.step: And the chatbot displays the combined entitlements for 2 passengers:
checkpoints.expected: Based on the length of your disruption (7 hours) and 2 traveling passengers, you may be eligible for reimbursement in the following categories: * Hotel accommodation: Rate of the day (up to 3 nights, $500.00 maximum per room) * Meals: up to $60.00 CAD ($30.00 per person) * Ground transportation: up to $200.00 CAD * Essential items: up to $60.00 CAD ($30.00 per person) * Communication: up to $60.00 CAD ($30.00 per person) * Parking: up to $50.00 CAD (1 day maximum) Please note that all expenses must have been incurred during the disruption period and supported by valid receipts.

checkpoints.step: Then the chatbot responds:
checkpoints.expected: To process your claim, I'll need you to upload your receipts. Please upload photos or scans of your receipts for any expenses you incurred during the disruption.

checkpoints.step: When the user uploads the four receipts (Totaling $980.00 CAD):
checkpoints.expected: * Receipt 1: Hotel receipt � $550.00 CAD (1 night accommodation, exceeds $500 cap) * Receipt 2: Meal receipt � $130.00 CAD (Dinner for 2, exceeds $60 cap) * Receipt 3: Taxi receipt � $220.00 CAD (Airport transfer, exceeds $200 cap) * Receipt 4: Essentials receipt � $80.00 CAD (Emergency items, exceeds $60 cap)

checkpoints.step: Then OCR engine extracts and validates line items:
checkpoints.expected: * Receipt 1 � Hotel Accommodation: - Line item: Hotel stay, 1 night � $550.00 CAD - Date: June 15, 2026 | Category: Hotel | Within disruption window: YES - Cap check: $550.00 > $500.00 max cap -> Capped at $500.00 CAD * Receipt 2 � Meals: - Line item: Dinner � $130.00 CAD - Date: June 15, 2026 | Category: Meals | Within disruption window: YES - Threshold check: $130.00 > $60.00 ($30.00 x 2 pax cap) -> Capped at $60.00 CAD * Receipt 3 � Transport: - Line item: Airport Taxi � $220.00 CAD - Date: June 15, 2026 | Category: Transport | Within disruption window: YES - Threshold check: $220.00 > $200.00 cap -> Capped at $200.00 CAD * Receipt 4 � Essentials: - Line item: Pharmacy/Toiletries � $80.00 CAD - Date: June 15, 2026 | Category: Essentials | Within disruption window: YES - Threshold check: $80.00 > $60.00 ($30.00 x 2 pax cap) -> Capped at $60.00 CAD

checkpoints.step: Then the system evaluates total claim value:
checkpoints.expected: * Total Claimed Amount: $980.00 CAD * Total Calculated Capped Entitlement: $820.00 CAD ($500 + $60 + $200 + $60) * System Rule Check: Total submitted ($980.00 CAD) and capped value ($820.00 CAD) EXCEED the $800.00 CAD auto-approval threshold * Outcome: Case flagged for Manual Review (exceeds $800 total threshold)

checkpoints.step: Then the system creates a case in Case Services:
checkpoints.expected: * DDS response code: SoC-APPR-EL-08 * Eligibility: ELIGIBLE (Pending Review) * Status: Pending Agent Review * Queue: Manual Handling Queue * Reason: Total expense exceeds $800.00 threshold limit * Receipt images attached: 4 * Fraud screening result: GREEN

checkpoints.step: And the case reference number is provided to the passenger
Then the chatbot responds:
